    Set sizes in ggplot uniformly

    dot-gg_set_size_defaults.Rd

    Set the default sizes of lines, points and fonts in ggplot geoms, and text labels in ggplot axes to get a single consistent look and feel.

    .gg_set_size_defaults(
  lineSize = 0.5,
  fontSizePts = 4 + lineSize * 8,
  font = "Roboto",
  size = lineSize * 2
)

    Arguments

    lineSize

    the width of lines (default `0.5` [numeric])

    fontSizePts

    the size of labels and other on plot text in pts. (default `4 + lineSize * 8`)

    font

    the font family name (default `Roboto` [character])

    size

    the size of points (the default size aesthetic) (default `lineSize * 2`)

    Value

    nothing

    Unit tests

    

.gg_set_size_defaults(lineSize = 0.25)
